hunks.old:
margin : column
            share 1
            role aside
            talked : column
              only when talk != ""
              list : column
                of lines:$d.talk about=$d.item as c
                each remark
            older : column
              of comments:$d.item as oc
              each oldremark
hunks.new:
margin : column
            share 1
            role aside
            notes : column
              role beside
              talked : column
                only when talk != ""
                list : column
                  of lines:$d.talk about=$d.item as c
                  each remark
              older : column
                of comments:$d.item as oc
                each oldremark
